## Historical Materialist Hook

[RESEARCH REQUIRED: The curriculum frames the formalization of propositional logic as the cognitive parallel to the industrial mechanization of physical labor. Utilize Karl Marx and Friedrich Engels's The German Ideology to establish the baseline mode of production and the division of labor that necessitated a new economy of thought. Use Alfred Sohn-Rethel's Intellectual and Manual Labour to analyze how purely syntactic rules structurally mirror the commodity form.]

## Core Technical Synthesis

[RESEARCH REQUIRED: Establish the foundational mechanics of symbolic representation. Analyze the use/mention distinction alongside the precise architectural construction of arguments. Detail the structural rules for generating well-formed formulas (wffs) in truth-functional logic (TFL).]

<div class="guided-example-title">
Guided Example: Well-Formed Formulas
</div>
<div class="guided-example-content">
A well-formed formula (WFF) strictly follows recursive rules.

Example of a WFF: `(P /\ (Q -> ~R))`
Example of a non-WFF: `P /\ Q -> R` (ambiguous scope)
</div>
:::
